description:
Join us as a Lead Operations Analyst at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with, skills to meet business requirement as well as job-specific skillsets.

To be successful as a Lead Operations Analyst, you should have experience with:

Basic Skills:
• Core technologies for the role includes f5 LTM, f5 GTM, Infoblox DDI, Blue Coat Proxy
• Data technologies: Routing & Switching, ACI, Firewalls, Wireless technologies
• OEMs: Cisco, Juniper, Bluecoat, Fortinet
• Load Balancing: Working knowledge of F5 LTM/GTM, VIPRION, and application traffic management concepts including VIPs, pools, SNAT, and SSL/PKI.
• DNS/DHCP & Proxy: Experience with Infoblox DNS/DHCP, proxy technologies such as Zscaler or Bluecoat, and basic automation/scripting.
• Troubleshooting: Proficiency with diagnostic tools including Wireshark, tcpdump, traceroute, nslookup, and dig for network and application connectivity issues.
• Networking: Strong expertise in routing protocols including EIGRP, OSPF, and BGP, and switching technologies such as Cisco ACI, NX-OS, VLANs, VPC, HSRP/VRRP, Catalyst, ASR, and CSR.
• Security: Hands-on experience with enterprise firewalls, preferably Fortigate, with exposure to Checkpoint or Juniper advantageous.
• Monitoring & Tools: Experience with network monitoring and automation tools such as Spectrum, NetBrain, Observe, and Ansible.
• Strong years of experience in network operations or support within large enterprise environments.
• Proven ability to operate in 24x7 global support models with strong ownership and accountability. This role requires candidate to work in 24/7 support.
• Minimum Graduation degree required. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience.
• Solid understanding of ITIL processes including Incident, Change, and Problem Management, and tools such as ServiceNow.
• Strong foundation in enterprise networking concepts, infrastructure operations, and incident lifecycle management.
• Demonstrated experience supporting business-critical network services in a controlled enterprise environment.

Desired Skills:
• CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent networking certification.
• ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent service management knowledge.
• F5, Fortigate, Cisco ACI, or cloud/network automation certifications would be advantageous.
• Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to perform under pressure.
• BFSI domain exposure is advantageous

This role is based out of Chennai.

Purpose of the role

To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.

Accountabilities
• Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
• Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
• Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
• Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
• Teamwork: Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
• Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

Analyst Expectations
• To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
• Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
• Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
• They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
• If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
• OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.

• Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
• Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
• Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.

• Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.

• Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.

title: Lead Business Analyst
description:
Join us as a Lead Business Analyst at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our API First digital strategy, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will lead the definition of business outcomes and translate complex customer, operational, regulatory, and technology needs into clear, actionable solutions that enable robust, scalable, and secure APIs.

To be successful in this role, you must have:
• Extensive experience leading business analysis across complex, multi-workstream software delivery programmes, from problem definition and discovery through implementation and outcome validation.
• Demonstrated ability to shape business analysis strategy, establish standards, and provide governance for requirements quality, traceability, and change control across large-scale initiatives.
• Advanced expertise in eliciting, analysing, challenging, and prioritising complex business, customer, regulatory, and operational requirements.
• Proven ability to translate strategic business objectives into clear product capabilities, end-to-end process designs, functional specifications, user stories, and measurable acceptance criteria.
• Strong leadership in facilitating senior stakeholder workshops, resolving ambiguity, managing conflicting priorities, and driving evidence-based decisions across business and technology teams.
• Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to communicate complex issues, options, dependencies, and recommendations to senior technical and non-technical audiences.
• Deep experience working with API and microservices-based architectures, including defining business capabilities, API requirements, data contracts, customer journeys, and integration dependencies.
• Strong understanding of banking and financial services, including customer, payment, servicing, operational, risk, control, compliance, and security considerations.
• Proven experience leading business analysis within Agile delivery models, partnering with Product Owners and engineering leads to shape roadmaps, manage backlogs, and maintain delivery readiness.
• Ability to define outcome measures, quality criteria, and business success metrics, and to use data and insight to support prioritisation and validate delivered value.
• Experience leading end-to-end business acceptance, including UAT strategy, scenario coverage, defect triage, operational readiness, and formal business sign-off.
• Strong risk and control mindset, with experience identifying delivery, operational, data, and regulatory risks and ensuring appropriate requirements, controls, and evidence are embedded in solutions.
• Advanced proficiency with requirements and collaboration tools such as JIRA and Confluence, with disciplined management of traceability, decisions, assumptions, dependencies, and scope changes.
• Strong leadership capabilities, with experience coaching and mentoring business analysts, reviewing analysis outputs, and raising capability and quality standards across distributed teams.
• Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in geographically distributed, cross-functional environments while maintaining accountability for analysis outcomes and delivery commitments.

Some other highly valued skills may include:
• CBAP - IIBA, Scrum Alliance Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM), or an equivalent business analysis or product certification.
• Experience shaping API-first digital products, developer experiences, external integrations, or platform capabilities within a large enterprise.
• Advanced data analysis skills, including SQL, data mapping, reconciliation, and the use of evidence to validate requirements and business outcomes.
• Knowledge of banking industry standards, regulations, and compliance requirements relevant to digital channels, APIs, payments, or corporate banking.
• Experience with business architecture techniques, capability modelling, value-stream mapping, operating-model design, and end-to-end process optimisation.
• Understanding of UX and service design principles, including customer journey mapping, prototyping, and accessibility considerations.
• Experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, or other process improvement methodologies to simplify customer and operational journeys.
• Familiarity with cloud technologies, event-driven architecture, API security, and non-functional requirements from a business and customer perspective.
• Understanding of testing strategies, quality engineering, test automation, and how acceptance criteria support continuous testing and delivery.
• Knowledge of change management, business implementation, communications, training, and adoption planning for organisational transformation.
• Experience defining product analytics, management information, dashboards, and benefit-realisation measures.
• Familiarity with DevOps and CI/CD practices, and their implications for incremental scope, release readiness, and business acceptance.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

The role is based out of Pune.

Purpose of the role

To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.

Accountabilities
• Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
• Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
• Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
• Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
• Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
• Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
• Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
• Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.

Vice President Expectations
• To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
• If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
• If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
• OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
• Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
• Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
• Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
• Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
• Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
• Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
• Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
• Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Director, Product Manager –Disputes
description:
Job Title:

Director, Product Manager –Disputes

Overview:

Location: Pune, India
Level: Director
Job Family: Product Management
Who is Mastercard?
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. We leverage data, technology, partnerships, and innovation to help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Overview
The Disputes Solutions team is seeking a Director, Product Owner to help define and execute Mastercard's vision for the future of dispute management. This leader will own strategic areas of Mastercard's next-generation disputes platform and be responsible for shaping the capabilities, experiences, and operating model that will power the future of dispute resolution across the global payments ecosystem.
Based in Dublin, this role will be embedded alongside product, engineering, architecture, data science, and design teams within co-located development pods. The successful candidate will act as a senior product leader, partnering with executives, regional stakeholders, customers, and technology teams to define product strategy, prioritize investments, and drive execution of platform capabilities at scale.
This individual will play a critical leadership role in driving Mastercard's AI strategy within the disputes organization, identifying opportunities to embed intelligence, automation, predictive decisioning, and generative AI throughout the customer and operational experience. The role will help establish AI-first ways of working across product and engineering pods while ensuring capabilities align with Mastercard's strategic priorities and customer needs.

Role
As a Director, Product Owner, you will:
• Define and own strategic platform domains within Mastercard's next-generation disputes ecosystem, establishing long-term vision, objectives, and measurable business outcomes.
• Translate corporate and product strategy into prioritized roadmaps that align customer needs, market opportunities, regulatory requirements, and technology investments.
• Partner with executive leadership to shape the future direction of Mastercard's disputes modernization strategy.
• Lead complex product discovery efforts, validating customer problems and defining innovative solutions that deliver measurable value.
• Drive product strategy and execution across multiple agile pods, ensuring alignment to roadmap commitments and strategic objectives.
• Own and prioritize large-scale product backlogs spanning multiple teams, products, and delivery streams.
• Establish product requirements, business capabilities, success metrics, and investment priorities for critical platform initiatives.
• Serve as the primary product authority for assigned platform domains, making high-impact prioritization and tradeoff decisions.
• Drive the adoption of AI technologies throughout the product lifecycle, including intelligent dispute processing, workflow automation, customer support experiences, predictive insights, and operational optimization.
• Champion AI-enabled product development practices and identify opportunities to leverage generative AI and advanced analytics to improve both customer outcomes and delivery efficiency.
• Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, Design, and Operations leadership to ensure scalable and sustainable platform evolution.
• Collaborate directly with customers, partners, and regional stakeholders to understand emerging needs, market trends, and competitive opportunities.
• Influence investment planning and strategic portfolio decisions through data-driven business cases and outcome-based prioritization.
• Present roadmap decisions, strategy updates, and investment recommendations to senior executives and business leaders.
• Act as a thought leader and coach across product teams, fostering a culture of innovation, experimentation, customer centricity, and continuous improvement.

All About You
The ideal candidate for this position should:
• Demonstrate deep expertise in product strategy, product ownership, and platform development.
• Possess a proven ability to define and execute product visions that span multiple products, teams, and stakeholder groups.
• Have exceptional leadership skills and the ability to influence outcomes across large, matrixed organizations.
• Be highly skilled at translating ambiguous business challenges into clear product strategies and actionable roadmaps.
• Demonstrate strong commercial acumen and the ability to evaluate investment opportunities against customer and business outcomes.
• Have extensive experience partnering with technology organizations to deliver complex enterprise-scale solutions.
• Be comfortable managing competing priorities while making strategic decisions that balance short-term delivery with long-term platform objectives.
• Possess exceptional communication and storytelling skills with experience engaging executive audiences.
• Have a passion for innovation and emerging technologies, particularly artificial intelligence and automation.
• Demonstrate a customer-first mindset and a track record of using customer insights to shape strategic decisions.
• Bring strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities and use data to inform prioritization and product investment decisions.
• Thrive in highly collaborative, agile, and fast-paced environments.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience leading large-scale SaaS, platform, fintech, banking, or payments products.
• Knowledge of disputes, chargebacks, fraud management, transaction processing, or case management ecosystems.
• Experience defining and executing AI, automation, machine learning, or data platform strategies.
• Proven success leading global product initiatives involving multiple markets, stakeholders, and delivery organizations.
• Experience driving platform modernization and enterprise transformation programs.
• Familiarity with product operating models, outcome-based planning, and scaled agile delivery frameworks.
• Experience influencing executive leadership teams and strategic investment decisions.

Success Measures
The successful candidate will:
• Establish and execute a compelling strategic vision for key domains within Mastercard's next-generation disputes platform.
• Deliver innovative product capabilities that strengthen Mastercard's market leadership and customer value proposition.
• Successfully scale AI-enabled capabilities across products, teams, and customer experiences.
• Drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, automation, and platform adoption.
• Create strong alignment between Product, Engineering, Architecture, Design, and Business stakeholders.
• Influence enterprise-level product strategy and portfolio investment decisions.
• Build high-performing product organizations that consistently deliver customer-centric outcomes.
• Accelerate the modernization of Mastercard's disputes ecosystem through innovation, technology leadership, and disciplined execution.
